items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: What happened to Andy Hardy? He played the hornbow. Did you play with him? No, I wouldn't play with him.

ctx.x: A natural death. A natural death.
A natural death. A little Hardy. Who? A little Hardy. Not even Hardy, man. He's Hardy. Who's the trumpet player, Doubles on the Tunnel? Tony? Tony?
